entities.name: Jerzy Prószyński
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jerzy Prószyński is a Polish arachnologist specializing in systematics of jumping spiders. He is a graduate of the University of Warsaw, a long-term employee of the Siedlce University of Natural Sciences and Humanities and the Institute of Zoology of the Polish Academy of Sciences in Warsaw.

entities.summary: Jerzy Prószyński is a Polish arachnologist specializing in systematics of jumping spiders.
